title: Thimble Shoal Channel Maintenance Dredging
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > SAD > W074 ENDIST WILMINGTON
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Enterprise Dredge Delivery Center (EDDC) requires a contract to provide maintenance dredging for Thimble Shoal Channel.  The work at Thimble Shoal Channel consists of maintenance dredging the Channel to a required depth of -57 feet MLLW. One (1) foot of overdepth dredging will be allowed as part of the contract dredging pay prism. Dredged material placement is within Dam Neck Ocean Disposal Site (DNODS) or Craney Island Dredged Material Management Area (CIDMMA) based upon channel stationing. Work may be performed by a hopper dredge, a mechanical dredge and scows, or a combination of the two. The following will be the performance period:05 March 2027 to 02 August 2027.  No hopper dredging from 01 September to 14 November. This solicitation is unrestricted. The contract issued will be Firm Fixed Price. The bid opening date will be January 05, 2027, as specified in the solicitation. No additional media (CD-ROM, floppy disks, facsimiles, etc.) will be provided. Paper copies of this solicitation will not be available. Other methods of requesting a package will not be honored.  The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 237990 - Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction and the size standard is $37,000,000.00.
